distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) accepts Taiwan occurrence for Xyleborus volvulus. The source-level taxonomic caveat concerning its distinction from X. perforans is retained separately and does not erase the accepted Taiwan record.

host_note: The source characterizes Xyleborus volvulus as strongly polyphagous but enumerates no host taxon in the curated record; no host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborus volvulus (Fabricius, 1775).

nomenclature_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) notes that the distinction between Xyleborus volvulus and X. perforans is doubtful. Current integrated taxonomic backbone nevertheless retains X. volvulus as VSN_6400 and X. perforans as VSN_6316; the 2010 uncertainty is preserved as source-specific taxonomic conflict without merging the stable identities.
